# Spit Wars

> Spit Wars is a free, turn-based artillery game where rival teams of llamas and
> alpacas lob spit bombs, mortars and missiles across destructible terrain. Play
> solo against AI, pass-and-play on one device, or battle a friend online. It runs
> in any web browser — no download, no payment.

## What it is

- Genre: turn-based artillery / "worms-like" strategy, casual and mobile-first.
- Teams: the **Llamas** (orange) vs the **Alpacas** (cyan), two units each.
- Each turn: move, pick a weapon, set angle and power, account for wind, fire.
- Terrain is destructible — every hit reshapes the battlefield.
- Free to play. Sign-in (email one-time code) is only needed for online play and
  saving win/loss stats.

## Weapons

- **Spit Bomb** (💦) — bounces once before it lands.
- **Mortar** (💣) — fixed high arc, big blast, power-only aim.
- **Missile** (🚀) — fast and barely affected by wind.
- **Air Strike** (🎯) — mark a target on the map for a precision drop.
- **Cluster** (💥) — splits into three on the way down.

## Game modes

- Solo vs AI (personalities: Karen and Chad).
- Pass-and-play local multiplayer on one device.
- Online multiplayer: sign in, create a room, share the 6-character room code.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://spitwars.com/): overview and play options.
- [Play Solo](https://spitwars.com/game): battle the AI or pass-and-play.
- [Play Online](https://spitwars.com/online): create or join a room.
- [Leaderboard](https://spitwars.com/leaderboard): top players ranked by wins.
